name: showreel-c3-card-margins

voice.text: This business card feels cheap. Why? Everything touches the edges. Turns out, margins make it calm. Fix one: pull everything in. Fix two: fewer lines. Fix three: one strong corner. Same card, now it feels premium.

caption:
This business card feels cheap. Why? Everything touches the edges. 💼

1. Pull everything in. A margin all round gives the card a frame; don't fear the empty space.
2. Fewer lines. Name, role, one way to reach you. The rest can live on your website.
3. One strong corner. Group what's left in one place, so it reads as one block, not a scatter.

Save this for your next card, badge or social post. What's the one line your card can't lose?

sources.title: Proximity Principle in Visual Design (Nielsen Norman Group)
